scope: Observed native macOS Tart proportional reader and Library Usage input, exact copy/export, navigation and retained-source-loss acceptance. Synthetic fixtures only.
wrapper_exit_context: Root intentionally stopped the owned Tart wrapper after the guest completed successfully.
artifact_manifest_hash_format: SHA256 of compact JSON mapping artifact-relative names to content SHA256, with sorted keys; source inventory remains in native-result.
export_mode: 0600 checked by the sealed guest new_export function before copying

bounded_report_limits.interpretation: Report bounds, not a performance or heap-memory measurement

observed_behavior: Proportional prose forward/reverse mouse selection preserved exact Unicode scalars, combining marks, CJK, emoji and tab bytes; a second range crossed wrapped rows.
Settings Back restored the partial wrapped prose selection without reselecting.
Compact/expanded disclosure, mouse and keyboard folds, canonical export, page changes and descriptor-limit plain fallback retained exact evidence.
Library Usage showed recorded counters and an unknown optional metric with the explicit unknown-is-not-zero notice.
All/Claude/Codex controls filtered capture rows; empty Codex activation stayed on the report. Both provider summaries remain visible by design.
Retained capture drilldown supported disclosure, canonical page export and Next/Previous; Back restored the report and original History selection.
limitations: Missing combining/CJK/emoji glyphs remain; exact copy passed but font fallback, shaping, grapheme behavior and IME are not established.
Usage is an all-time textual report; charts, activity-date filtering, cost/account integration and full visual parity are not implemented by this slice.
Inherited toolbar status-hint hit-area overlap is separately recorded for repair.
No pending-worker Close, accessibility, resize, or performance acceptance.
Close numbers are observation upper bounds including polling overhead, not app latency measurements.
The Bend oracle uses the same production layout/projection dependencies; it is not an independent proof of every rendering algorithm.
Native Shift-Tab effect was observed, but NSBackTab25 delivery inside the app was not instrumented.
Stale asynchronous callback injection remains pure-model evidence; it was not injected into the native application.
This focused journey is not a fresh full-suite pass or a same-host Swift-versus-Bend benchmark.
publication_safety: Only synthetic test metadata, relative artifact names and hashes are copied. No screenshot pixels, databases, transcript contents, private histories, advisor logs or host paths are included.
